what_this_is: OI-357's PRODUCTION-ARM run, on the user's Ruling 35(b) of 2026-08-09: a bounded EXPLORATIONAL run of the arm that ships over the derived partial-signature population, whose outputs live in a scratch directory and nowhere else. It takes no verdict; the comparison is performed by `gen_oi357_partial_signature_establishment.py --run-dir`, the SAME tool the committed-outputs pass used (#6).
the_row_it_feeds: OPEN_ITEMS.md OI-357 (and OI-363, which gains the production-arm column beside its committed-outputs one)

★_the_bounds_this_run_was_performed_insi.the_gate_is_unmoved: This repertoire is not the gate corpus, and nothing here promotes it. The research-tier-on-entry rule in `CLAUDE.md` gate block (A) is untouched.
★_the_bounds_this_run_was_performed_insi.explorational: #5 fact-finding under the scope-of-surprise clause: a surprise here is ROWED, and nothing is designed or fixed for it.

★_the_flag_is_the_point.why_it_is_not_optional: Without `--joint-inference` batch_analyze runs the LEGACY pipeline (`BUILD_AND_TEST.md`, the corrected invocation note), which is exactly the arm the committed outputs already are — a flag-less run would answer nothing.
★_the_flag_is_the_point.why_the_preset_is_named_and_why_it_does_: Production inference is PRESET-INDEPENDENT (`CLAUDE.md` gate block (A), the OI-178 adoption), so the preset is a presentation carrier here. It is stated because a recorded invocation must be reproducible, not because it moves a value.

★_the_reproducibility_stamps_16.how_the_corpus_hash_is_built: sha256 over the sorted (piece, sha256-of-.mscx) pairs of every score this run read. Derived, so a corpus that moves cannot be mistaken for the one measured.

the_population.how_it_is_derived: IMPORTED from gen_oi357_partial_signature_establishment.py — the evidence document's own stated method, applied to every piece in the corpus metadata. Not re-implemented here (#6), so the two passes cannot drift apart in what they are about.
the_population.★_what_a_limited_run_is_worth: A limited run is a diagnostic, not a measurement of the population: reading it as one is the silent cap the standing rules forbid. The flag above says which this is.
